 Print ‘Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend’, which arrived in theatres on November 5, has maintained a strong hold at the box office, with audience appreciation and the Diwali festive period contributing to its impressive run. After a brief setback on its second day, the Ranbir Kapoor and Yash starrer picked up pace over the weekend before delivering an extraordinary performance on Monday. The film has now followed up its massive Monday numbers with another strong collection on Tuesday, while continuing its run on Wednesday. It benefitted hugely from the Diwali and then Bhai Dooj period and may now see a drop from Thursday onwards, till the second Saturday-Sunday. The film has seen growth due to positive word of mouth and more than the domestic numbers, it has seen a strong hold at the worldwide box office. Ramayana Movie Review According to Sacnilk, the film began its theatrical journey with Rs 64.85 crore net in India on Thursday. Collections witnessed a decline of around 25 per cent on Friday, with the film earning Rs 48 crore. However, it recovered remarkably on Saturday, bringing in Rs 69.80 crore and comfortably moving past its opening-day figure. The film added another Rs 56.15 crore to its tally on Sunday. What followed was an unprecedented surge on Monday, its fifth day in theatres, when the collections jumped by 91.5 per cent to Rs 107.50 crore net. The film continued its strong run on Tuesday, collecting Rs 94.10 crore despite weekday ticket discounts. On Wednesday, day 7, the film witnessed a dip, earning Rs 70.65 crore. On Thursday, so far the film has collected Rs 53.50 crore. With this, its total domestic box office collection has reached Rs 564.60 crore net. Day wise collection of 'Ramayana: Part 1'

 Day 7 (Wednesday) - Rs 70.65 crore Day 8 (Thursday) LIVE - Rs 53.50 crore Total net collection in India - Rs 564.60 crore The film's Tuesday performance is particularly noteworthy, considering that weekday discounts on ticket prices generally help attract audiences during the first week of a theatrical release. Despite the expected midweek fluctuation, the film has managed to maintain substantial footfalls, indicating sustained audience interest beyond its opening weekend. On the global front, ‘Ramayana: Rise Of A Legend’ has also delivered an impressive performance, taking its worldwide box office collection to Rs 673.90 crore. The film's consistent theatrical performance, coupled with the festive boost, has further established it as one of the year's major box office successes. Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' box office collection day 8: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi starrer enters Rs 1,000 Cr club; becomes 11th Indian film to achieve milestone Directed by Nitesh Tiwari , the epic mythological drama features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble cast also includes Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana, alongside several prominent actors in pivotal roles.
